stats.noCities: No place has a city recorded.

rhythm.title: Rhythm
rhythm.streakDesc: consecutive days with at least one visit
rhythm.undatedNote: {{count}} visits carry no date. They are in the totals but on no chart — they have no day.
rhythm.undatedNote_one: One visit carries no date. It is in the totals but on no chart — it has no day.
rhythm.charts: Visits per year, month and weekday

insights.title: Insights
insights.loadFailed: The insights could not be loaded.

discoveries.title: Discoveries and returns
discoveries.empty: Appears once a dated visit is over.

help.unit: One visit. A first visit is a place's earliest dated visit; every later one is a return.
help.time: Year on the place's own calendar (its time zone), not your device's.
help.source: Your visits to places in your logbook.
help.coverage: {{unordered}} dated visits belong to places with an undated visit — whether they were the first, nobody knows, so they are in neither column. {{withoutDate}} places have no dated visit at all, {{undated}} visits are undated.
help.exclusions: Wishlist places and visits dated in the future do not count.

returning.title: Returning after a long break
returning.empty: Appears once you return to a place on a second day.

help.unit: The break between two consecutive visits to the same place; whole years count from anniversary to anniversary.
help.time: Days on the place's own calendar.
help.source: Your dated visits per place. The list names places you visited in several calendar years.
help.coverage: Only visits with a known day measure a break.
help.exclusions: Undated visits, the wishlist and planned visits.

variety.title: Variety per trip
variety.description: Most different place categories on one trip
variety.empty: Appears once visits belong to a trip.

help.unit: One place category (restaurant, landmark, nature …), counted once per trip, city or year.
help.time: A trip counts in the year of its first dated visit; years on the place's own calendar.
help.source: The place's category, the visit's trip, the place's city.
help.coverage: {{withoutTrip}} visits belong to no trip and are missing from the per-trip view.
help.exclusions: The wishlist and planned visits. Cities are told apart by name and country.

documentation.title: Documented
documentation.description: {{photo}} with a photo · {{note}} with a note · {{rating}} with a rating – of {{count}} visits
documentation.empty: Appears with the first past visit.

help.unit: One visit. Photo, note and rating are each counted on their own, never folded into one score.
help.time: Year on the place's own calendar; undated visits count only in the lifetime figure.
help.source: Photos attached to the visit itself, the visit's note and its rating.
help.coverage: A trip photo not attached to any visit does not count here.
help.exclusions: A missing rating is not a bad one — none is ever asked for or filled in.

jump.title: Largest jump
jump.empty: Appears once two visits to different places are recorded in a certain order.

help.unit: Kilometres in a straight line between two places — explicitly not the distance travelled.
help.time: Two visits that directly follow each other, by day and — on the same day — by time.
help.source: The coordinates of the places you visited.
help.coverage: {{uncertain}} pairs of visits on the same day without a time are in an unknown order and are not measured; {{undated}} visits without a day are in no sequence.

visitedPlaces.unit: A place in the logbook that counts as visited — three visits to one café are one place.
visitedPlaces.time: All years: every visited place. A year: a place with a past visit dated in that calendar year (the date entered at the place).
visitedPlaces.source: Your places and their visits (the places list).
visitedPlaces.coverage: A place marked visited without a dated visit counts in the lifetime figure but in no year.
visitedPlaces.exclusions: Places on the wishlist and places whose only visit is still in the future.

wishlist.unit: A place you have saved but not visited yet.
wishlist.time: Shown only for all years: a wishlist has a state, not a date.
wishlist.source: Your places that do not count as visited.
wishlist.coverage: A place whose only visit is still ahead is listed here: planned is not visited.

visits.unit: A visit — three visits to one café are three.
visits.time: A visit counts once its date has passed; for a year only visits dated in that year.
visits.source: The visits at your visited places.
visits.coverage: Undated visits count in the lifetime figure but in no year and in no chart.
visits.exclusions: Visits still in the future, and places on the wishlist.

countries.unit: A country, counted by the place's country code — "Deutschland" and "Germany" are one country.
countries.time: As for "Places visited": for a year only places with a visit in that year.
countries.source: The country code the place search resolved for each place.
countries.coverage: A place without a resolved country code counts in no country.
countries.exclusions: Wishlist places; the free-text country name is not read.

cities.unit: A city, by the name the place search wrote — there is no code for a city.
cities.source: The city field of your visited places.
cities.coverage: Places without a city count in none; two cities of one name in different countries are one here.

lists.unit: A list — your own and subscribed checklists alike.
lists.time: Shown only for all years: a list is something you keep and belongs to no year.
lists.source: Your place lists and the checklists you subscribed to.
lists.coverage: Every list counts, an empty one too.
lists.exclusions: Checklists you have not subscribed to.

byCategory.unit: Visited places per category, each place once.
byCategory.source: The category of each visited place.
byCategory.coverage: Every place has exactly one category (unset: "Other").

mostVisited.unit: Visits per place; the name opens the place.
mostVisited.time: Past visits count; for a year only that year's.
mostVisited.source: The visits of each visited place.
mostVisited.coverage: Undated visits count while no year is selected.
mostVisited.exclusions: Future visits and places without a counted visit.

byCountry.unit: Visited places per country, by country code.
byCountry.source: The country code of each visited place.
byCountry.coverage: Places without a resolved country code are missing from this list.

byCity.unit: Visited places per city, by city name.
byCity.source: The city field of each visited place.
byCity.coverage: Places without a city are missing from this list.

checklists.unit: Ticked entries of a checklist out of all its entries; ordered by share, not by count.
checklists.time: Shown only for all years: today's state.
checklists.source: The checklists you subscribed to and their ticked entries.
checklists.coverage: Only checklists with at least one ticked entry are listed.
checklists.exclusions: Your own lists have no progress and are not listed.

busiestMonth.unit: The calendar month with the most visits, summed over all years; on a tie the earlier month.
busiestMonth.time: The month of the entered visit date — the clock at the place, not your device's.
busiestMonth.coverage: A visit recorded in the Companion app close to midnight can land one day off. {{undated}} undated visits are in no month.
busiestMonth.exclusions: Undated visits, future visits, wishlist places.

busiestWeekday.unit: The weekday with the most visits; on a tie the earlier one, counting from Sunday.
busiestWeekday.time: The weekday of the entered visit date at the place.
busiestWeekday.coverage: {{undated}} undated visits are on no weekday.
busiestWeekday.exclusions: Undated visits, future visits, wishlist places.

busiestDay.unit: Distinct places on one calendar day — two visits to one place that day are one; on a tie the earlier day.
busiestDay.time: The day of the entered visit date at the place.
busiestDay.coverage: {{undated}} undated visits belong to no day.
busiestDay.exclusions: Undated visits, future visits, wishlist places.

streak.unit: Consecutive calendar days with at least one visit; on a tie the earlier run.
streak.time: Calendar days of the entered visit date at the place — a clock change breaks no run.
streak.coverage: {{undated}} undated visits cannot extend a run.
streak.exclusions: Undated visits, future visits, wishlist places.

charts.unit: Visits per year, per month (all twelve, empty ones too) and per weekday.
charts.time: The entered visit date at the place.
charts.coverage: {{undated}} undated visits count in the totals above but in no chart.
charts.exclusions: Undated visits, future visits, wishlist places.

average.time: As for "Visits": for a year only that year's visits.
average.source: The rating you gave a visit.
average.exclusions: A visit without a rating is not a zero and drags nothing down — it is simply left out.

bestRated.unit: The five highest ratings of single visits; ties by name.
bestRated.coverage: A place with several rated visits can appear more than once.

firstVisit.time: The entered visit date; for a year the earliest of that year.
firstVisit.coverage: An undated visit may have been earlier — nobody knows, so it is not considered.
firstVisit.exclusions: Undated visits, future visits, wishlist places.

favourite.unit: The place with the most visits, from two on; ties by name.
favourite.source: The visits of your visited places.
favourite.coverage: Undated visits count while no year is selected.

categoryCoverage.unit: A place category carried by at least one visited place, out of all categories in the catalogue.
categoryCoverage.source: The category of your visited places and the fixed category catalogue.
categoryCoverage.coverage: Every place has exactly one category.

extremes.unit: The visited place with the highest or lowest latitude.
extremes.source: The coordinates of your visited places.
extremes.coverage: Every place has coordinates; if two share the exact latitude, the evidence names both.
extremes.exclusions: Wishlist places — even one further north.

onTrips.unit: A visit filed on a trip — a visit, not a place, belongs to a trip.
onTrips.source: The trip entered on a visit.
onTrips.coverage: Out of {{total}} visits; visits without a trip are not in it.
onTrips.exclusions: Future visits; a trip is never guessed from a date.

csv.title: Places from a spreadsheet
csv.description: A CSV file with names and coordinates. Without coordinates the place lands in the preview and you set its position yourself — which is also how a Google Takeout export the geocoder cannot resolve gets in.

preview.needsInputHint: Rows without a position or with a possible duplicate need your decision before the import starts. Nothing is written without it.
preview.commitError: The import failed. Please try again — whatever was already written is in the import log.

errors.noRows: No row in this file carries a name — is the “Name” column mapped correctly?
errors.parseFailed: The file could not be read.
errors.previewFailed: The preview could not be loaded.

commitResult.partial: {{created}} place(s) created · {{skipped}} already here · {{failed}} not imported ({{reasons}})
commitResult.takeoutExtra: {{stops}} added as trip stops · {{stays}} recognised as your stays
commitResult.stopsSkipped_one: {{count}} trip stop skipped — the trip already has it on that day
commitResult.stopsSkipped_other: {{count}} trip stops skipped — the trip already has them on that day

takeout.intro_one: {{count}} row comes from a Google Maps list. Position, trip and visit day can be suggested — you then decide row by row.
takeout.intro_other: {{count}} rows come from a Google Maps list. Position, trip and visit day can be suggested — you then decide row by row.

errors.failed: The suggestions could not be fetched. The rows stay as they were — you can still set their positions yourself.
errors.lost: The server lost the search (restart?). Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many imports in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes.

summary.dated: with a visit day from photos

trip.found: Trip: “{{name}}” — visits and trip stops are assigned to it.
trip.no_country: The list's name names no country, so no trip is assigned and no name search is run.
trip.no_trip: You have no trip to this country — no trip is assigned.
trip.several_trips: You have several trips to this country — which one it was is your call; none is assigned.

takeout.noKey: This instance has no Google Places key configured (Settings → Integrations). Positions therefore come only from the name search inside the list's country.

positionReasons.timeout: Google did not answer in time
positionReasons.not_found: Google does not know the place
positionReasons.not_in_country: not found in the list's country
positionReasons.limit_reached: search limit for one run reached

sources.name_search: Position via name search — please check

dayReasons.ambiguous: no day: photos on several days equally often

document.title: A place from a document
document.description: A museum ticket or a tour booking: paste its text or choose a PDF, .eml, .msg or .txt file. It is read like any other document, with your place templates from the parser workshop; the place lands in the preview, and only you create it.
document.placeholder: Paste the text of the ticket or booking here …
document.readFailed: The document could not be read. Please try again.

fallback.noTemplate: No place template is active yet. In the parser workshop (document type: place), derive one from a ticket of this provider, check it with the preview and activate it.
fallback.notRecognised: None of your place templates recognises this document. For a new provider, derive one of its own in the parser workshop.
fallback.timedOut: Reading took too long and was stopped. Please try again.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.coverFailed: The cover photo could not be saved.
gallery.makeCoverHint: Tap a photo to make it the cover.

delete.photos_one: Along with it goes one proof photo.
delete.photos_other: Along with them go {{count}} proof photos.
delete.lists_one: It leaves the list {{names}}; the list itself stays.
delete.lists_other: It leaves {{count}} lists ({{names}}); the lists themselves stay.
delete.stations_one: One roadtrip station that names it is kept.
delete.stations_other: {{count}} roadtrip stations that name it are kept.

visit.unknownHint: The visit is saved without a date — it still counts.
visit.aheadHint: This day is in the future: the visit is planned and only counts once it has happened. You can add photos afterwards.
visit.tripsFailed: Your trips could not be loaded. You can still let the visit be filed by its date.
visit.photosHint: Up to {{max}} photos — they are uploaded as soon as the visit is saved.
visit.photoFailed: The photos could not be uploaded.

merge.title: Merge a duplicate · {{name}}
merge.intro: “{{name}}” stays. Choose the duplicate that should be folded into it — then decide, for each detail, which one is kept.
merge.pickFailed: Your places could not be loaded.
merge.apart: The two positions are {{metres}} m apart.
merge.failed: The places could not be merged. Nothing was changed.

errors.bothCurated: Both places are checklist entries — merged, one tick would be lost. Nothing was changed.
errors.same: A place cannot be merged with itself.

impact.title: Moving from “{{name}}” to “{{kept}}”:
impact.lists_other: {{count}} lists: {{names}} — where the place is in one already, it stays one entry
impact.unknown: What moves could not be counted — every visit, photo, document and list moves along anyway.
impact.visited: The place counts as visited, because one of the two was.
impact.wishlist: The place stays on the wishlist.
impact.refKept: Its source reference is kept as a second reference — a later import still finds it.

curated.twoLists: “{{kept}}” and “{{other}}” are entries of two checklists ({{lists}}). Merged, one tick would be lost — so both stay.
curated.sameList: “{{kept}}” and “{{other}}” are two different entries of the checklist {{list}}. Merged, one tick would be lost — so both stay.

nearby.title: Nearby
nearby.subtitle: Your saved places around a lodging or a point — no location permission needed.

origin.title: Starting point
origin.lodgingsFailed: Your lodgings could not be loaded.
origin.noLodgings: No lodging with a location. Choose a place or point.
origin.unplacedLodgings_one: One lodging without a location cannot be chosen.
origin.unplacedLodgings_other: {{count}} lodgings without a location cannot be chosen.
origin.pointLabel: Search a place or set a point
origin.deviceHint: Your location is asked for once, for this view only — it is stored nowhere. Without permission, a lodging or a point works just as well.
origin.device_denied: Location not permitted. Choose a lodging or a point instead.
origin.device_unavailable: Your location is not available right now. Choose a lodging or a point instead.
origin.linkedLodgingUnusable: This lodging has no location — choose another starting point.

results.title: Places
results.noOrigin: Choose a starting point — a lodging, a place or a point on the map.
